fusions.name: Crossing Guard
fusions.desc: You heave and thrash, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. On a hit, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lumbering Rush
fusions.desc: A heavy rush at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full range, and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Ruminating Bask
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow-Building Heft
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: your damage rises 6% per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
